title: Subtitles never cost the picture
description: Serves "Their languages come first."; "Any film plays, and plays well.".
acceptanceCriteria: A subtitle the player can show (text, and image subtitles on Android) is shown by the player, so choosing it changes nothing in the picture.
The picture is converted to carry a subtitle only for a player that can show none of it.
Switching subtitles mid-film is quick and doesn't restart the picture.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
